# Artifact Gateway v0.8.0

## 简体中文

本次整批包含 OCI 标准匿名上游 Bearer 交换、Maven/OCI 合法重定向逐跳出站策略、仓库统计分页与总览加载优化。Gateway、Console、OpenAPI 契约及发行材料统一为 0.8.0；Gateway 与 Console 必须使用本次同一发行 revision。

原生 OCI Proxy 可显式配置 `ociBearer.realm` 和 `ociBearer.service`，绑定签发者、受众及仓库 pull scope。默认禁用；token 仅在进程内有界缓存，不持久化，不转发客户端凭据。签发者配置不自动授予网络许可。Maven/OCI 重定向逐跳沿用获准 HTTPS、精确来源/端口、最多五跳、认证隔离和统一取消/超时预算；纯 HTTP 或未批准的跳转明确失败。

仓库使用统计支持服务端分页、字面量地址搜索和匹配/全仓总计。容量聚合避免重叠 Maven 路径重复计数；总览存储及统计独立于分组与最近审计加载并支持独立重试。主题切换保留最后接受的选择，Console 回归明确等待快照 effect 和页面业务状态，保留原断言与超时。`golang.org/x/text` 更新到 0.42.0，处理 GO-2026-6629，依赖审计不增加例外。Gateway 与 Go sidecar 使用 Go 1.26.9 构建，补齐发行审计发现的标准库安全修复；`golang.org/x/net` 更新至 0.60.0 及必要依赖版本，修复同批 HTTP/2 审计发现。

### 从 v0.7.0 升级

正式 v0.7.0 的 migration ledger 为 142 项；本次完整账本为 144 项。`000143_artifact_usage_paging.sql` 为使用统计增加排序索引，`000144_oci_bearer_configuration.sql` 为仓库增加 nullable JSONB 配置列。已应用 SQL 的内容和 checksum 不改写；执行前核目标账本，仅依序应用缺失项。普通索引建立需按目标数据量安排窗口。升级前按[恢复手册](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.8.0/docs/recovery-runbook.zh-CN.md)验证完整写入者范围的 PostgreSQL/S3 配对备份，独立保管配置及加密 key。不要混跑新旧 Gateway，也不要通过 down migration 或删列回退；回退依赖升级前一致快照和匹配旧软件。

发布不代表生产已升级或代理接入已验收。生产负责人下一阶段确认具体源、端口、issuer/service、获准 CDN/egress、既有读取身份、缓存预算及窗口，然后创建所选 Proxy 和对应读取 Group。Maven 初期仅承诺 Release 范围；OCI 公共来源使用明确入口或单来源组，不复制串行跨源 fallback。真实验收需要空客户端的 Proxy/Group 冷/热下载、完整镜像 manifest/config/layers/digest 和 K8s 拉取解包运行。GitLab/GHCR 实际公共内容及私有上游认证仍需明确，不以合成测试代替生产证据。

## English

This batch adds opt-in anonymous upstream OCI Bearer exchange, per-hop egress enforcement for approved Maven/OCI redirects, repository usage pagination and independent overview loading. Gateway, Console, OpenAPI contracts and distribution materials use 0.8.0 and must be paired at this release revision.

Native OCI Proxy repositories bind an explicit `ociBearer.realm` and `ociBearer.service` to the issuer, audience and repository pull scope. Existing repositories remain disabled by default. Tokens have bounded process-local storage and lifetime; client credentials are not forwarded. Issuer configuration grants no network permission. Redirects retain approved HTTPS origins/ports, a five-hop bound, credential isolation and one cancellation/timeout budget; HTTP-only or unapproved chains fail closed.

Usage lists support server pagination, literal address search and matching versus whole-repository totals. Capacity aggregation counts overlapping Maven paths once. Overview sources load and retry independently. Theme choices preserve the last accepted selection; Console regressions explicitly settle snapshot effects and assert page readiness without weakening assertions or timeouts. `golang.org/x/text` becomes 0.42.0 for GO-2026-6629 without an audit exception. Gateway and Go sidecars are built with Go 1.26.9 for the standard-library security fixes required by release audit; `golang.org/x/net` becomes 0.60.0 with its required module closure for the related HTTP/2 audit findings.

### Upgrade from v0.7.0

The formal v0.7.0 ledger contains 142 migrations; this release contains 144. `000143` adds a usage sorting index and `000144` adds nullable OCI Bearer configuration. Preserve applied SQL/checksums and apply only missing entries in order after checking the target ledger. Schedule normal index creation for the target data size. Use the [recovery runbook](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.8.0/docs/recovery-runbook.md) to validate a paired PostgreSQL/S3 backup across all writers, keeping configuration and encryption keys separate. Do not mix Gateway revisions, attempt down migrations or drop configuration columns; rollback requires the paired pre-upgrade snapshot and matching old software.

Publication does not establish production deployment or proxy acceptance. The production owner must confirm exact upstream/issuer/CDN/egress bindings, existing read identities, cache budget and execution window before creating Proxy repositories and their read Groups. Maven starts with Release-only scope; public OCI sources use explicit entry points or single-source Groups. Verify fresh-client cold/hot reads through Proxy and Group, all selected-platform image bytes/digests, and Kubernetes pull/unpack/run. Real GitLab/GHCR content and private upstream authentication remain separate acceptance work.
